name: @anvilary/workbench
description: Anvilary Workbench: local visual interface for coding-agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, and Pi)

scripts.build: node scripts/workbench/check-desktop-build.mjs && node packages/server/scripts/build-bundle.mjs && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-web build
scripts.check:e2e: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server exec tsx scripts/check-agency-e2e.mjs && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server exec tsx scripts/check-agency-remediation.mjs && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server exec tsx scripts/check-workbench-integration.mjs
scripts.check:systemd: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server exec tsx scripts/check-workbench-lifecycle.mjs && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server exec tsx scripts/check-native-systemd.mjs
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-shared run test:unit && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop run test:unit && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server run test:unit && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-web run test:unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop run test:integration && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server run test:integration && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-web run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-web run test:e2e && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop run test:e2e
scripts.test:runtime: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server run test:runtime && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop run test:runtime
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server run test:security && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop run test:security
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-shared test && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-desktop test && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-server test && pnpm --filter @anvilary/workbench-web test
